answer: Each PoA agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE for SGX, or the corresponding SEV measurement) and a hardware-protected key. A verifier accepts messages only when an attestation quote proves that approved code runs in genuine enclave-capable silicon. Copying keys or software into virtual machines cannot mint identities; cloning requires separately purchased physical hardware, preventing an island of VM replicas from echoing over copper.
